titles.description: A cikin shirin Dadin Kowa Kashi 114 Dantani baki har kunne, ya angwance da Amaryarsa Furera....Ta yi tsami tsakanin Gimbiya da Haidar. Shin ina dalili? Damuwa da tsoro, sun saka Rambo ya yanke hukuncin rabuwa da duniya. Shin wacece ta kwanta dama a cikin wannan shirin na Dadin Kowa?

titles.name: Dadin Kowa Ep 113
titles.description: Kamun da jami’an tsaro su ka yi wa Timo wata babbar nasara ce gare su, shin hakan zai kai ga fallasuwar asirinsu ko kuma za ta sauya zani ne? A bangaran Alawiyya tura ta kai bango wahala ta yi wahala cikin gidansu, shin akwai wani sauki ko haka za su kasance har abada. Domin ganin yadda za ta kaya mu hadu shirin Dadin kowa kashi na 113

titles.name: Dadin Kowa Ep 112
titles.description: A cikin shirin Dadin Kowa kashi na 112 Mal. Kabiru da Ladidi na cikin matsanan ciyar rashin lafiya da Alawiyya taci gaba da fafutukar nema musu sauki...Hauwa da Goshi sun gamu da balahirar yan' damfara....Anya babu lauje cikin nadi tattare da abokin tafiyar Jawo?....Kilu-ta-ja bau, Jajen da Zubaida ta je yiwa Nazir, yasa Mal. Bello daukan hukunci mai tsanani akan Nazir.

titles.name: Dadin Kowa Ep 111
titles.description: Mu je zuwa! Delu Cogal ta tayar da kayar baya don ganin sai Mal. Kabiru ya cika mata burinta. Badaru dangatan Baraka, har ta fara dorashi kan hanya a yayin da Mal. Kabiru ya canza taku, dangane da rigimar da ke wakana a gidansa. Dantani kuwa ya bada himma, amma anya babu wani daurin boye tsakaninsa da Mal. Hassan? Rambo ya ga ta kansa. Allah Ya arawa su Madina rana. Su Hauwa kuwa ba su ga tsuntsu

titles.name: Dadin Kowa Ep 110
titles.description: Malam Kabiru na kwance a gadon asibi rai kwakwai mutu kwakwai. Hankalin Laadidi da Alawiyya ya kara tashi, yayin da Likita ya bukaci a bayar da kudi ko Kuma a sallame su. Ladidi ta ci gaba da neman wayar Aminu domin ya kawo gudunmawar kudi, ana cikin haka sai ga Delu Chogal ta shigo ta zo asibinta jakarta cike da kudi, sai da abinda ba a sani ba shine z ata iya ceto ran Malam kabiru da kudin ta ?

titles.description: A cikin shirin Dadin kowa kashi na 109 Ladidi ta yanke hukuncin karshe akan Aminu idan har ba dawo gida ba...A ya yin da Mal. Kabiru ci gaba da rashin lafiya mai tsanani, Alawiyya da Gimbiya sun ci gaba da fafutukar nema masa lafiya...Ina makomar Nazir da aka kama, ake tuhuma da laifi?

titles.name: Dadin Kowa Ep 108
titles.description: Tsuguni-tashi bata kare ba, a yayin da Mal. Kabiru yake jin jiki ga shi kuma asibitoci na tsaka da yajin aiki, bug da kari ba kudi a hannun su Alawiyya. Madina da Zuby baki har baka don sun tare a sabon gida. Kakar Rambo tana cikin rashin lafiya, ga kuma Rambo bayanan. A bangare guda su Badaru da Wizzy sunyi abin kirki, amma fa Ojukwu ya sasu a kwana. Anya kuwa asirin Timo bai gama bankaduwa ba?

titles.name: Dadin Kowa Ep 107
titles.description: Allah Ya tarfawa garin su Madina nono. Su Hauwa kuwa ba su ga tsuntsu balle tarko domin can suka dangana ga ‘yansanda. Delu Cogal ta tayar da kayar baya don ganin sai Mal. Kabiru ya cika mata burinta. Dantani kuwa tafiya tayi nisa, amma anya babu wani daurin boye tsakaninsa da Mal. Hassan? Badaru danlelen Baraka, har ta fara dorashi kan hanya a yayin da Mal. Kabiru ya canza taku dangane da rigimar

titles.name: Dadin Kowa Ep 106
titles.description: A cikin shirin Dadin Kowa, kashi na 106 A dai dai lokacin da taci gaba da kokarin komawa makaranta, Gimbiya ta shiga wani mawuyacin halin tsaka mai wuya sanadiyar zargin da ake yi mata na sace kudin Mal. Kabiru....Me ya faru lokacin da Delu Cogal ta yi takakkiya zuwa gidan Mal. Kabiru? Me Gimbiya ta yi don kare kanta daga zargin da ake yi mata?

titles.name: Dadin Kowa Ep 105
titles.description: Malam Kabiru ya angwance da Delu Chogal kishi kuma ya tashi, inda Malam Kabiru ke kokarin hanata yin bara. A gefe guda kuma, Malam Kabiru yaci alwashin gano barawon da yayi masa sata, inda ya bukaci a ja masa yasin mai fiffike. Zaman gidan Sister Iyabo ya gagari Stella inda ta nemi komawa gidan Olabode... Shin Olabode zai amince ya dawo da ita kuwa?

titles.name: Dadin Kowa Ep 103
titles.description: Maryam ta shiga wani kangi bayan abin da ya faru ranar daurin auranta na Nazir don ta kasa gane menene makomar auransu. Yayin da a gefe Mal. Kabiru ya bullo da wata sabuwa ga Gimbiya. A bangaran Ujuku wani mummunan abu na shirin faruwa gareshi, domin ganin yanda za ta kasance mu kalli shirin Dadin kowa kashi na 103

titles.name: Dadin Kowa Ep 102
titles.description: KANWA TA KAR TSAMI An raba gado, su Hauwa sun kama tasu hanyar. Ranar daurin auren Nazir ta zo. Malam Kabiru ya shagala da tattauna kudin sadakin da zai biya wajen auren Delu Cogal. An ja kunnen Haidar akan Gimbiya a gidansu, a yayin da Gimbiya ta shiga wani sabon farin ckin. Asirin Malam Kabiru ya tonu.

titles.name: Dadin Kowa Ep 101
titles.description: Tsananin soyayyar da Stella ke yiwa Wizzy tana neman kaita ta barota, domin tana gab da rasa auranta. Yayin da a gefe guda halin buya da rashin madafar da Rambo ke ciki ya fara damunsa, domin ya yi biyu babu. Dubun kamal ta cika domin yana gab da shiga komar jami’an tsaro.
